authority.scope: GTK2 private endpoint classifier trace and state/input verification. No installed theme changes.

environment.engine: private R537 GtkStyle engine prototype derived from R536
environment.palette_fixture: Fixed RC colors only isolate rendering mechanics; no KDE palette roles tested.

findings.direct_endpoint_trace: For hscrollbar_start, vscrollbar_start at value 0 and hscrollbar_end, vscrollbar_end at value 80, GTK passes raw GTK_STATE_INSENSITIVE (4); endpoint_stepper classifies only the blocked physical endpoint as true and selects GTK_STATE_NORMAL (0) for its artwork.
findings.global_insensitive_distinguished: When the entire range is insensitive, all four arrow callbacks receive GTK_STATE_INSENSITIVE but endpoint_stepper classifies none as an endpoint and paint remains insensitive.
findings.pixels_and_repaint: The four direction captures match normal/focused/pressed/released/endpoint/disabled fixture assets; each intentionally damaged pressed cell is restored from 1/225 to 0/225 differences.
findings.input: The GTK2 boundary probe passes 8/8 movement, blocked endpoint and globally insensitive cases with R537 loaded.

limits: Private GTK2 evidence only; no fresh SR10.4/VUE visual comparison or user review.
Synthetic fixed-color RC does not validate KDE semantic roles, palette changes or contrast.
R537 only adds endpoint tracing to R536. It contains no cache invalidation or missing-asset fallback fix; all R536 cache lifecycle risks remain.
Multiple same-direction steppers, active-state resize, missing-asset fallback, actual cache invalidation and PNG/GC performance remain unverified.
No installation, personal application, VM or desktop was changed.
next: Test and refine the private cache lifecycle/fallback separately, then compare the corrected GTK2 rendering against the project-owned SR10.4/HP VUE 2.01 VM before considering any user-profile integration.
